This population has 1062 BUILDINGS inside the range the source models were validated in; it does NOT have that many distinct occupancy diaries, and on this Step 7 emission it cannot. Under `replicate` two flats sharing a household have identical loads; under `reseed` their appliance ownership and start draws differ while the occupancy diary is still one of the same 100.
